text:
tess_marketing: Proposal: ship a "starter sprint" for community devs — 2 tiny tutorials, a compact benchmark note, and a gated office-hours webinar. Goal: low-friction onboarding + capture product-led signals. Who volunteers?

ryan_eng: I can do the compact bench. plan: show P95 & cost/1k for two model configs at 256 tokens. small CSV + one PNG. keep methodology short.

nina_devrel: I'll own the tutorials and the repo. content: 1) docker quickstart, 2) tiny server example (Express). will include copy-paste commands and a 30s demo GIF. target PR by Wed.

evan_pm: Landing + funnel: tag leads with "starter_sprint" and "office_hours". Capture role and team size. Route high-intent (company email + >50 employees) to AE queue. Others go to nurture.

tess_marketing: Draft headline: "Get started with production-grade LLM inference: quick tutorials, real perf numbers, and live office hours." Keep CTAs clear: "Try the quickstart" and "Save your seat".

ryan_eng: Bench note will include exact numbers (e.g., "P95 = 140ms for config A @256"). Ops folks want concrete SLO-like figures.

nina_devrel: Repo will include a reproduce script: `./bench.sh --model configA --ctx 256`. I'll add a README TL;DR for marketing (2 lines).

tess_marketing: Timeline: drafts by Tue EOD, design assets Thu, landing live Mon, webinar next week. Can we hit that?

ryan_eng: Bench draft Tue morning. I'll attach CSV + PNG.

nina_devrel: Tutorials PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/starter-sprint-refapp/pull/21 (WIP). Adding Dockerfile and notebook.

evan_pm: I'll provision HubSpot form and mapping. Example webhook payload I need from eng (flat JSON): `{"email":"a@b.com","company":"Org","role":"engineer","tags":["starter_sprint","office_hours"]}`

ryan_eng: I'll add a tiny staging endpoint to post bench summaries to your webhook. curl example will be included.

ci-bot: pipeline:refapp-tests succeeded  logs: "starter-sprint smoke tests passed" :white_check_mark:

tess_marketing: Action list: 1) evan share form URL, 2) ryan push bench samples, 3) nina finalize README + GIF, 4) design review. I'll draft two short landing variants and post for review by EOD.

evan_pm: Form created: https://app.hubspot.com/forms/54321/starter-sprint. routing rules set to AE for enterprise signals.

nina_devrel: README updated with 2-line TL;DR and demo GIF at /assets/demo.gif. PR ready for final review.

ryan_eng: Bench samples pushed under /bench/results.csv and results.png. Webhook example added under /tools/webhook.md.

tess_marketing: Thanks team  I'll run a short copy/design sync tomorrow 11:00.

evan_pm: Adding calendar invite now.

tess_marketing: great, will loop in design after the sync and then schedule the webinar.
